newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Metway merger will see high earnings-chairman.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Metway merger will see high earnings-chairman.

text.p: Metway Bank Ltd chairman Frank Haly said combined net profits of a merged Metway-Suncorp-Queensland Industry Development Corp (QIDC) would have reached A$180 million in the current year to June 30, 1997.

"Had the combined group been operating in the current year, net earnings would have reached $180 million," Haly told a press conference on Wednesday following release of merger documents on the planned merger.
"In the full year 1998, earnings would reach $220 million and in 1999, they are likely to climb to $250 million," he said.

The earnings estimates compare with independent expert Grant Samuel's report which gives actual net earnings of a combined Suncorp and QIDC business of $40.9 million in the year ended June 30, 1996 and a net profit of $41.69 million reported by Metway in its latest 1995/96 year.
